# Lobby signature fixtures (Sprint 5 R47, plan Amendment A6)

Grayscale crops of real 640x448 captures from Sprint 5 Task 1 launch 8, read by
`tools_py/tests/test_lobby_resend.py`. The source captures live under git-ignored `logs/parity/`;
`make_fixtures.py` in this folder is the record of each crop and regenerates them
(`python tools_py/tests/fixtures/lobby/make_fixtures.py` from the repo root). The tests paste each crop back into
a black 640x448 frame at its box, so the detectors read the same pixel coordinates as a live frame.

Launch report: `.superpowers/sdd/2026-09-13-sprint-5-control-readout-and-first-kill/task-1-launch8-report.md`.

| fixture | source capture | box (x0, y0, x1, y1) | what it shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `map_8b_pre.png` | `s5_t1_launch8b_medley/A_14b_map_medley.png` | 335, 110, 625, 380 | SELECTED MAPS panel before the map CROSS |
| `map_8b_post_dropped.png` | `s5_t1_launch8b_medley/A_15_play_list.png` | same | after the CROSS (and SQUARE): byte-identical, the CROSS was dropped (8b's lobby failure) |
| `map_8c_pre.png` | `s5_t1_launch8c_medley/A_14b_map_medley.png` | same | before the map CROSS (same bytes as 8b's) |
| `map_8c_post_taken.png` | `s5_t1_launch8c_medley/A_15_play_list.png` | same | after the CROSS and SQUARE: Medley listed, mean abs diff 8.95 |
| `ready_8a_A_dropped.png` | `s5_t1_launch8_medley/A_19_ready.png` | 14, 150, 175, 190 | 3 s after A's READY CROSS: still READY, label right edge col 48 (8a's lobby failure) |
| `ready_8a_B_taken.png` | `s5_t1_launch8_medley/B_19_ready.png` | same | 3 s after B's CROSS: NOT READY, edge col 83 (82 on the later holds) |
| `ready_8c_A_left_lobby.png` | `s5_t1_launch8c_medley/A_19_ready.png` | same | 3 s after A's CROSS on 8c: no label (the match was launching), not retried |

Caveat: no saved capture shows the SELECTED MAPS panel after a taken CROSS *alone*. The taken fixture is after
CROSS + SQUARE (8.95). The one CROSS-only reading is 8c's live driver log: 3.52 (`drive_s5_t1_launch8c_medley.txt`),
which is why `MAP_CROSS_DROPPED_MAX_DIFF` is 1.0 rather than the driver's 3.0.

## On-screen keyboard text row (Sprint 6, `osk_typed_count`)

Full-width crops of rows 220..256 (the keyboard's text row is 228..250), read by `tools_py/tests/test_osk_typing.py`
and regenerated by `make_screen_fixtures.py`. Each typed glyph is a run of light-grey columns (max 100-200, 3-11 px
wide) separated by 2-3 dark columns from col 31; the white cursor block (max > 200, 5 px) after the text BLINKS
(absent in 7 of the 12 per-key captures) and the font is proportional, so the count is the number of glyph runs.

| fixture | source capture | what it shows | count |

| `osk_text_empty_cursor_oldharness.png` | `s6_ladder_oldharness/A_04_pw_kbd.png` | just opened (normal mode), cursor block on at cols 30..34 | 0 |
| `osk_text_soc_cursor_match.png` | `ours_match/B_name_key2_c.png` | "soc" with the cursor on (cols 56..60) | 3 |

## Main-menu rows and the persona stage (Sprint 6, launch s6_ladder7, `press_online` / `press_persona`)

Cut by `make_login_path_fixtures.py`, read by `tools_py/tests/test_login_path.py` (and the pre-login test in
`test_online_login_lobby.py`). The block-pointer exe's main menu is NEW GAME / ONLINE / LAN; the lit row's text pulses
in size (ONLINE lit spans x 267-370 here, 243-394 in wtb4's and 3b's captures), so `menu_online_lit` reads the median
of each row's text core (x 262-368): lit 114-146, dim 15-43 over every capture. No capture shows this layout with
NEW GAME lit (every pre-login timeout capture -- wtb4, 3b, s6_ladder7 -- has ONLINE lit: the DOWN registered and the
CROSS was dropped), so the tests build that frame by swapping the lit and dim crops.

| fixture | source capture | box (x0, y0, x1, y1) | what it shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu_row_new_game_dim_lad7.png` | `s6_ladder7/A_lobby_fail_pre-login.png` | 262, 278, 368, 296 | NEW GAME dim (median 35.5) |
| `menu_row_online_lit_lad7.png` | same | 262, 312, 368, 332 | ONLINE lit (median 141) |
| `menu_row_lan_dim_lad7.png` | same | 262, 348, 368, 364 | LAN dim (median 24) |
| `menu_row_online_login_screen_lad7.png` | `s6_ladder7/B_00_login.png` | 262, 312, 368, 332 | the login screen at ONLINE's row (median 36) |
| `osk_panel_form_lad7.png` | `s6_ladder7/B_02_persona.png` | 20, 200, 475, 432 | the CONNECT TO SOCOM II form, cursor on PASSWORD, before the first persona CROSS |
| `osk_panel_kbd_lad7.png` | `s6_ladder7/B_03_name.png` | same | the password keyboard open over it (accent mode): whole-frame mean abs diff 16.5 live, 9.9 when only this box is pasted |
